reopening.reason: Missing owned raw static class, weapon, auxiliary-registry, per-loadout reference, and reciprocal-topology authorities required before WP03.

blockingFindings.summary: Cargo target_subsystem_source_key and armor, weapon, and turret *_source_key values remain raw engine indices instead of capture-local opaque or canonical keys.
blockingFindings.requiredDisposition: Replace every leaking engine index with a capture-local owned key and prove no raw index, pointer-like value, or recycled source identity survives capture.

blockingFindings.summary: Named auxiliary-register homonyms are merged silently, while AmbiguousAuxiliaryName is incorrectly raised for unnamed patterns that have distinct closed pattern codes.
blockingFindings.requiredDisposition: Reject ambiguity for the six named registries without index-based disambiguation, and key the pattern registry only by its closed firing-pattern code.

blockingFindings.summary: The has_complete_typed_catalog branch lets the test seam avoid the exhaustive production mapper; negative cmeasure_firewait is coerced to zero; and a bank with num_slots equal to zero can remain Valid in the seam.
blockingFindings.requiredDisposition: Exercise one exhaustive production mapper from the seam, reject negative cmeasure_firewait instead of clamping it, and reject zero-slot banks before any candidate can be treated as Valid.

closurePreconditions: Fresh red evidence names and fails every B1, B2, and B3 contract case.
Production fixes are independently bound by current source hashes.
Fresh targeted and broad retests pass on the corrected artifacts.
The certification sequence records exact commands, exit codes, durations, artifacts, and expected skips.
An independent rereview returns GO with zero blocking findings.
This report is rewritten with fresh evidence and a new post-write SHA-256 before either downstream authorization is restored.
